Name: Extra Stables for Solid Foundations
Author: SiTheGreat1
Description:
Adds extra stables. These are separate from the vanilla stable, and do not come with a horse. I made this for myself to use with the stray horses you can adopt from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt 'n' Skin[/url], but feel free to use them for whatever you want. This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12311]Solid Foundations[/url].

This mod includes two stables: the vanilla version, and a flipped version. This mod SHOULD be compatible with everything Solid Foundations is compatible with, but let me know if you run into any issues.

These stables:
[list]
[*]Do NOT include a horse
[*]Are cheaper than the vanilla stable
[*]Don't require any materials to purchase
[*]Don't need any build time (they're constructed immediately)
[*]Will not have your horse automatically return to them in the morning (it will go to its usual stable/place)
[*]Become translucent when you stand behind them
[*]Include painting options at Robin's
[/list]
These stables [b]aren't [/b]affected by any horse stable reskin mods; you're welcome to replace this mod's images with ones of your choosing for your own save, just make sure the image names match. The images can be found in the mod folder:
[i]Extra Stables for SF > Buildings > Stable 1 > building.png
[/i](Stable 2 for the flipped one)
(Note: you may also have to replace the paint mask image as well)
There's a video by BethKitten in the Videos tab showing how to do this.

You can find me @SiTheGreat on the SDV Discord server, feel free to ping me with any questions!
